mapper.sql: id, merchant_id, merchant_owner_member_id, requester_member_id, requester_role_code, filter_json, include_paid_amount, status, version, row_limit, row_count, storage_key, token_hash, request_id, error_message, expires_at, started_at, finished_at, downloaded_at, download_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from merchant_crm_export_task t where t.id = #{taskId} and exists ( select 1 from mms_merchant m where m.id = t.merchant_id and m.member_id = t.merchant_owner_member_id and m.status = 1 and m.account_status = 1 and m.del_flag = 0 ) limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_crm_export_task (merchant_id, merchant_owner_member_id, requester_member_id, requester_role_code, filter_json, include_paid_amount, status, version, row_limit, row_count, storage_key, token_hash, request_id, error_message, expires_at, download_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{merchantRowId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{requesterMemberId}, #{requesterRoleCode}, #{filterJson}, #{includePaidAmount}, 'PENDING', 0, #{rowLimit}, 0, null, #{tokenHash}, #{requestId}, null, #{expiresAt}, 0, now(), now())
mapper.select: select from merchant_crm_export_task where expires_at > #{now} and (status = 'PENDING' or (status = 'RUNNING' and (started_at is null or started_at <= #{staleBefore}))) order by create_time asc, id asc limit 1
mapper.update: update merchant_crm_export_task set status = 'RUNNING', started_at = #{startedAt}, storage_key = #{storageKey}, error_message = null, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{taskId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and expires_at > #{startedAt} and (status = 'PENDING' or (status = 'RUNNING' and (started_at is null or started_at <= #{staleBefore}))) and exists ( select 1 from mms_merchant m where m.id = merchant_crm_export_task.merchant_id and m.member_id = merchant_crm_export_task.merchant_owner_member_id and m.status = 1 and m.account_status = 1 and m.del_flag = 0 )

update merchant_crm_export_task set status = 'SUCCESS', row_count = #{rowCount}, storage_key = #{storageKey}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{taskId} and status = 'RUNNING' and version = #{expectedVersion} and exists ( select 1 from mms_merchant m where m.id = merchant_crm_export_task.merchant_id and m.member_id = merchant_crm_export_task.merchant_owner_member_id and m.status = 1 and m.account_status = 1 and m.del_flag = 0 )

update merchant_crm_export_task set status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{taskId} and status = 'RUNNING' and version = #{expectedVersion}

update merchant_crm_export_task t set t.status = 'FAILED', t.error_message = '门店归属已变化，导出任务失效', t.storage_key = null, t.token_hash = '', t.finished_at = #{finishedAt}, t.version = t.version + 1, t.update_time = now() where t.id = #{taskId} and t.version = #{expectedVersion} and t.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'SUCCESS') and not exists ( select 1 from mms_merchant m where m.id = t.merchant_id and m.member_id = t.merchant_owner_member_id and m.status = 1 and m.account_status = 1 and m.del_flag = 0 )
mapper.select: select from merchant_crm_export_task where expires_at <= #{now} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED') order by expires_at asc, id asc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from merchant_crm_export_task where storage_key = #{storageKey}
mapper.update: update merchant_crm_export_task set status = 'EXPIRED', storage_key = null, token_hash = '', version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{taskId} and expires_at <= #{now} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED')

update merchant_crm_export_task set downloaded_at = #{downloadedAt}, download_count = download_count + 1, update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and merchant_owner_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and id = #{taskId} and status = 'SUCCESS' and expires_at > #{downloadedAt} and exists ( select 1 from mms_merchant m where m.id = merchant_crm_export_task.merchant_id and m.member_id = merchant_crm_export_task.merchant_owner_member_id and m.status = 1 and m.account_status = 1 and m.del_flag = 0 )
